Split nine oversized Rust modules into wiring-only parents

Pure-move refactors split nine files over the 800-line limit into
function-named submodules with wiring-only parents. AgentOperationRunner
methods use statement macros; review completion persistence is extracted
to finalize_review_completion_persistence.

cargo check: codeon OK, codeon-tracker agent_selection OK.
codeon-server blocked by console build.rs (missing node TS deps).
